title: Contrastive Identification and Generation in the Limit
abstract: arXiv:2605.06211v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In identification in the limit (Gold, 1967), a learner reads positive examples and must eventually name the target hypothesis; in generation in the limit (Kleinberg and Mullainathan, 2024), it must eventually produce new positive examples. We study a weaker, relational signal: each observation is an unordered pair $\{x,y\}$ with $h(x)\neq h(y)$, such as a cannot-link constraint or a dissimilar-pair label, and the learner never learns which point is positive. All our results come from one object: a pair is valid for every member of a finite family exactly when its points lie in antipodal cells of the family's membership map. (1) For every corruption budget $k$, known or unknown, we characterize exactly the identifiable classes. Incomparable hypotheses must cover the domain and share more than $2k$ points, and Angluin's tell-tale sets must survive the loss of $2k$ points. Every unbounded budget makes any two hypotheses confusable

translated_title: 极限中的对比识别与生成
translated_abstract: 在极限识别中（Gold, 1967），学习者读取正例样本并必须最终说出目标假设；在极限生成中（Kleinberg和Mullainathan, 2024），学习者必须最终产出新的正例样本。我们研究一种更弱的、关系性的信号：每个观测是一个无序对 $\{x,y\}$，满足 $h(x)\neq h(y)$，例如cannot-link约束或不相似对标签，而学习者永远不知道哪个点是正例。我们的所有结果都源自一个对象：当且仅当一个样本对的两个点位于某个有限族隶属映射的对极单元中时，该样本对对该族的每个成员都是有效的。（1）对于每个破坏预算 $k$（无论已知还是未知），我们精确刻画了可识别的类。不可比较的假设必须覆盖整个域并共享超过 $2k$ 个点，且Angluin的示警集必须在丢失 $2k$ 个点后仍然存活。任何无界的预算都会使任意两个假设变得不可区分。
tldr: 本文提出基于对比关系信号（即不相似样本对）的极限识别与生成新理论，精确刻画了在有限破坏预算下假设类可识别的条件，并证明无界预算会使任意两个假设都变得不可区分。
